title: Bi-Attention HateXplain : Taking into account the sequential aspect of data during explainability in a multi-task context
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured hate speech and unintentional bias against specific communities, including religious groups. It assessed a model's ability to correctly classify toxic comments targeting these groups and the fairness of these classifications.
findings: The proposed BiAtt-BiRNN-HateXplain model demonstrated improved performance, reduced unintentional bias, and enhanced explainability in the hate speech detection task. While religion was a component of the targeted communities in the dataset (e.g., Islam), the findings were general to the model's architectural improvements rather than specific to its performance on religious hate speech.
